nodes.name: New Email (Gmail Trigger)
nodes.notes: Set Gmail credentials. Add sender allowlist filter once Phase 10 KB exists.

nodes.name: Parse Email Headers
nodes.notes: Adjust field paths if your Gmail node output format differs (raw vs parsed mode).

nodes.name: WHOIS Lookup (Sender Domain)
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_API_KEY. neverError=true so a lookup failure doesn't kill the run.

nodes.name: Domain Age Flag
nodes.notes: Fixed to re-merge with the full pre-WHOIS item via $('Parse SPF/DKIM/DMARC') so fields aren't lost.

nodes.name: Homoglyph / Typosquat Check
nodes.notes: Fixed to re-merge original item + AbuseIPDB fields; expand brandList for your environment.

nodes.name: Check Prior Sightings (Google Sheets)
nodes.notes: Point at the Phase 10 Knowledge Base sheet once it exists.

nodes.name: Extract URLs & Compute Entropy
nodes.notes: Returns one item per unique URL found. If no URLs, returns an empty array and this branch simply produces no output for that email.

nodes.name: Compute VT URL ID
nodes.notes: VirusTotal v3 requires the URL identifier as unpadded base64url of the URL string.

nodes.name: VT URL Report
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_VT_API_KEY. neverError=true — an unknown URL returns 404, handled downstream rather than failing the run.

nodes.name: Wait for Scan
nodes.notes: urlscan needs time to render/screenshot the page. 40s is a starting point — increase if results come back incomplete.

nodes.name: Parse URL Verdict
nodes.notes: credential_form_detected_heuristic is a best-effort string match on the urlscan response, not a real DOM parse — treat as a hint, not a verdict.

nodes.name: Aggregate URL Results
nodes.notes: Combines every analyzed URL into one url_analysis array on a single item.
